verdict.rationale: Mastra docs show tool-level approval gating (`requireApproval: true` with a `tool-call-approval` chunk) and an isolated sandbox for multi-tool 'Code mode' execution, plus enterprise RBAC/IAM controls, which together map onto the guardrails story. However these are thin, first-party-only mentions with no independent verification of sandbox robustness and no detailed fine-grained per-tool permission/ACL system beyond a boolean approval flag. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of sandbox isolation, a documented granular permission model (e.g., per-tool scopes/roles), and more detail on how RBAC ties to individual tool calls.
